name: Melia Orlando Celebration
positioning: Meliá Orlando Celebration is a family resort in Celebration, the Orlando community created by The Walt Disney Company, and an Official Walt Disney World Good Neighbor Hotel with free transfers to the Disney Parks
best_for: Families visiting the Walt Disney World parks
Families and groups wanting two-bedroom suites with a full kitchen

facts.text: The hotel is in Celebration, a community in Orlando created by The Walt Disney Company.
The hotel is an Official Walt Disney World Good Neighbor Hotel.
The hotel offers free transfers to all the Disney Parks.
The hotel is 4.5 km from Disney World.
The hotel is 13 km from Universal Epic Universe.
The Two-Bedroom Family Suite has a king bedroom, a second bedroom with two full-size beds, a lounge with a sofa-bed and a full kitchen with a dining table.
The hotel has a wellness centre spa.
The hotel offers activities for children and on-site entertainment.
With The Level, a personal concierge handles pre-arrival planning, priority restaurant reservations and tailored recommendations.
The Level Lounge offers three hours of complimentary alcoholic beverages each afternoon.
The Wilson serves coastal cuisine with global influences and seasonally inspired cocktails.
The hotel has a pet-friendly program for dogs with special amenities and natural and organic products.

highlights.text: The hotel has a 360-degree infinity pool.
The Level Family Suite has a terrace, a master bedroom, a family room with bunk beds, a lounge and a kitchen.
The Level guests have reserved cabanas in the pool area.
The resort has its own minigolf course.
The hotel's leisure programming includes live performances and seasonal activities.

considerations.text: Disney World is 4.5 km from the hotel, which offers free transfers to all the Disney Parks.
The lounge drinks, reserved pool cabanas and personal concierge belong to The Level service.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing during peak Disney seasons.
